t: The Nebo Big Larry 2 is a versatile 2-in-1 LED worklight and torch, delivering powerful illumination for various tasks. Ideal for electricians working in dark voids, plumbers under sinks, or mechanics in a workshop, this robust lighting tool provides essential visibility. Constructed from durable, anodised aircraft-grade aluminium, it offers water and impact resistance, ensuring reliability on site or at home. A strong magnetic base and steel belt clip allow for convenient hands-free operation. Users can choose between a 500 lumen COB area light, a 200 lumen torch, and a 40 lumen red COB mode for emergency signalling. The dimmable function and memory power recall enhance usability, providing optimal light control.
